summary: Continues #1989 and #1007. Compared actual habits, ideal dispositions, constitutive practices, evolutionary/functional and truth-sensitive realization accounts under a fixed classical interpretation. Exhaustive Python comparison of four valuations, four acceptance profiles and all Boolean classifiers confirms failure exactly for equal acceptance data. Thin F6 excludes denial of every reason for the same relation; denial of irreducibility is not that denial. Existing warranted acceptance and reason bearer routes retain their exact bridges.
